title: How human is the machine? Evidence from 66,000 Conversations with Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper empirically investigates cognitive biases and decision-making heuristics (e.g., anchoring, framing, endowment effect) in LLMs. While it mentions ethical use and unbiasedness in its discussion and citations, it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical frameworks as a core component of its benchmarking or methodology.
